meaning_fixes.reason: 増援を確認！気をつけてください！ refers to the enemy's added forces, confirmed by the surrounding lines (一体、どっからわいて来るんだ！ 'where do they all come from!', dialogue_12386). 'Backup' reads as friendly reinforcement arriving, which contradicts the paired 'be careful' warning. Fits the 32-char budget (30 chars).
阻止しきれない！ specifically means failing to block/stop the enemy's advance, not failing to endure. 'Can't hold on' shifts the sense to endurance/stamina. Fits the 14-char budget exactly.

押されている……！ describes being overwhelmed/pressed by the enemy (passive), not a decision to retreat. The identical phrase is correctly rendered 'Pushed back, us!?' at dialogue_12479 in the Char/Sazabi table later in the corpus, and no actual withdrawal follows here -- the pilot is still holding a line two rows later at dialogue_12432 ('Not getting through!'), so 'Falling back' contradicted the pilot's own next actions. Fits the 16-char budget (15 chars).
